_comment: Seed pain-point categories. Claude assigns each mention to one of these ids (or 'other' with a free-text sub_issue). The consolidation step then clusters sub_issues into themes inside each category, so new problems still surface even if they are not listed here.

categories.name: Missed / unreliable collection
categories.description: Pickups missed, late, irregular, collectors not showing up, schedules changed without notice, recycling dumped with trash by the collector.

categories.name: Confusing sorting rules
categories.description: Not knowing what is recyclable, inconsistent rules between cities/councils, plastic resin numbers, labels on packaging, wishcycling.

categories.name: No access / drop-off points
categories.description: No recycling for apartments or rural areas, nowhere to take e-waste, batteries, glass, textiles, hazardous items; recycling centres far away or closed.

categories.name: Booking systems, apps & digital service
categories.description: Recycling-centre booking slots, pickup apps not working, app pickups cancelled, poor online information, website/phone booking problems.

categories.name: Low / unfair payout for scrap
categories.description: Kabadiwala/scrap dealers paying too little or cheating on weight, scrap rates opaque, buy-back programs not worth it.

categories.name: Deposit-return & reverse vending
categories.description: Bottle/can deposit machines broken, full or queues, redemption centres closed, refunds refused, DRS rollout problems.

categories.name: Fees & cost
categories.description: Charges for recycling, garden-waste fees, bulky-item fees, rising bills, paying for a service that is not delivered.

categories.name: Distrust: does it really get recycled?
categories.description: Belief recycling goes to landfill or is exported/burned, mixing of segregated waste, greenwashing by brands or municipalities.

categories.name: Bins & containers
categories.description: Bins too small, not provided, damaged, stolen, overflowing, too many bins, no space to store them, communal bins dirty.

categories.name: Rejections, fines & enforcement
categories.description: Bins rejected or tagged for contamination, fines for wrong sorting, neighbours contaminating shared bins, lack of enforcement of segregation rules.

categories.name: Customer service & accountability
categories.description: Unresponsive council/hauler/company support, complaints ignored, no one accountable, long hold times.

categories.name: Dumping, burning & littering
categories.description: Waste dumped on streets or vacant lots, open burning, landfill fires, overflowing public dumps as a consequence of broken recycling.

categories.name: Hard-to-recycle materials
categories.description: Soft plastics, styrofoam, tetra paks, mattresses, solar panels, cooking oil, medicines, textiles - where the main complaint is about one material type.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Homeowner / independent house
personas.description: Lives in a house with its own bins or kerbside collection; pays council tax or hauler fees directly.

personas.name: Apartment / society resident
personas.description: Renter or owner in a flat, apartment complex, gated community or Indian housing society / RWA building; shared bins or society-managed collection.

personas.name: Landlord / property or society manager
personas.description: Manages bins, contracts or rules for a building, complex or residents' welfare association.

personas.name: Small business / shop / office
personas.description: Restaurant, shop, office, café, trades - commercial waste contracts, cardboard, trade waste.

personas.name: Scrap seller / deposit redeemer
personas.description: Sells newspaper, metal, e-waste to kabadiwalas or scrap yards, or returns bottles and cans for deposit refunds; cares about price and payout.

personas.name: Eco-conscious / zero-waster
personas.description: Motivated by environment; tries hard to sort, compost and reduce; frustrated by systems and greenwashing.

personas.name: Waste worker / collector / insider
personas.description: Collector, binman, pourakarmika, MRF or recycling-industry worker speaking from the inside.

personas.name: General citizen
personas.description: Customer or resident whose housing or role cannot be inferred.
